note: GrowBot 85mm forward model (physical imagination). Predicts the change in the phone IMU over one 20 ms tick from the last 5 (imu, action) pairs, newest first. imu9 = [sin r, sin p, sin y, cos r, cos p, cos y, gyro_r, gyro_p, gyro_y]; action2 = [aRight, aLeft] radians of leg swing, same units the walk policy emits. Trained on the MuJoCo twin in policy/Harsh_policies/DR_RMA_EXPORT.
